newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs to drift lower, eyes on stocks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs to drift lower, eyes on stocks.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: NO OPERATION
*The key June 10-year JGB futures are expected to show downward bias on Tuesday. Selling is likely to emerge if Tokyo share prices stay above 20,000, traders said.
*Market watching March machinery orders data due 0500 GMT.
*NCB and LTCB expected to announce terms for May five-year bank debentures sometime in afternoon.
